question: Estimate Punctual Pros revenue from public filings
html:
Punctual Pros revenue estimate

Punctual Pros' FY2025 pro forma revenue is est. ~$22M (range $16–28M), with roughly $18M from Pennsylvania and $3–5M from New Jersey (Punctual Pros public filings). Confidence is medium. The estimate blends payroll-implied scale with franchise disclosure benchmarks. Neither method is a reported figure.

How the estimate is built

  • Pre-deal base: The Rohrer Company's April 2020 PPP loan of $745,985 implies $3.58M of 2019 payroll. That points to ~50–58 employees and est. $9–12M of 2019 revenue, assuming payroll is 30–40% of revenue (Punctual Pros public filings).
  • Growth to the BSP deal: About 113 employees by 2024, at Lancaster trade wages of ~$76K and a 40–45% labor ratio, supports an est. $18–22M Pennsylvania run-rate (Punctual Pros public filings). The 113 figure has not been re-verified (BSP firm profile).
  • Franchise cross-check: The 2026 franchise disclosure document lists 25 territories: 19 in Pennsylvania and 6 in New Jersey. Mapping these to Item 19 quartiles gives est. $12–19M for Pennsylvania and $3–5M for New Jersey (Punctual Pros public filings).
  • Add-on scale: Horvath Home Services' PPP loan of $251,894 implies est. $3–4M of 2019 revenue (Punctual Pros public filings).

Key estimates

MetricEstimateConfidence
FY2025 Pennsylvania revenue~$18M (range $12–24M) est.Medium
FY2025 New Jersey revenue~$3–5M est.Medium
FY2025 pro forma total~$22M (range $16–28M) est.Medium
Revenue per territory~$0.9M est. (system avg. $0.61–0.66M)Low
Adjusted EBITDA~$1.8–3.1M est. (central ~$2.6M)Low

Margin and leverage context

  • Royalty (6%) plus brand fund (~1.2–1.5%) takes ~7.2–7.5% of revenue, about $1.6M a year. This caps adjusted EBITDA margins at roughly 8–14% (est.) (Punctual Pros public filings).
  • A lender's June 30, 2026 quarterly filing shows a first-lien loan to the portfolio company's holding entity. It has $4.83M funded at SOFR+5.00% (8.73%), matures March 26, 2029, and is marked at ~98.6% of par. There is also a $1.4M unfunded commitment (Punctual Pros public filings).
  • Debt looks modest against est. EBITDA. The leverage ratio is not computed here because EBITDA confidence is low.

Caveats

  • Revenue per territory runs well above system averages. This may reflect strong operations, or it may mean the blend overstates revenue.
  • The filings set was verified on Sept 24, 2026: 30 items sampled, 29 confirmed, 1 removed (Punctual Pros public filings).
  • Actual revenue requires management accounts or the quality-of-earnings report from the April 3, 2024 purchase.

Next actions

  1. Reconcile the est. $22M against FY2025 management accounts and the deal quality-of-earnings report.
  2. Pull territory-level revenue to test the $0.9M per-territory figure against Item 19 quartiles.
  3. Re-verify current headcount and wage rates to refresh the labor-ratio method.
  4. Confirm actual royalty and brand-fund payments to tighten the EBITDA margin range.
